These days I’m spending most of my time figuring out how to take an AI capability from “interesting prototype” to something customers can actually use every day. My main stack is TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and AWS, with Python coming in whenever the AI/data side needs it. I’m especially interested in connecting with people working on AI-native products, developer tooling, agent workflows, and modern SaaS architecture.
